proofs.label: a different padlock
reasons: Couldn't confirm this is the same padlock. Although both are dark rusted iron padlocks with a thick U-shackle on white, the bodies are fundamentally different. Photo A has a complex plate-built body with side protrusions, wavy silhouette and circular through-holes plus a rivet on the shackle joint. Photo B has a plain solid rectangular box body with smooth sides, no holes and no rivet, and a taller shackle opening. The silhouette difference cannot be explained by opposite-side view, so they are different physical objects.
